about_the_game:
The Gates of Hell have burst open.
Relentless waves of ever-stronger creatures are spilling into our world — from vicious hellhounds to towering devils. With every passing minute, chaos draws closer. Time is against you. You must survive, adapt, and carve your own path to victory.

3 Playable Classes in the Demo: Warrior (pure combat), Mage (power through magic), Artisan (crafting and upgrades).

Every decision matters:

  • Dare to step into the fog of war for epic loot, or methodically clear safer regions?

  • Buy, loot, or craft your arsenal?

  • Crush enemies, bribe them, or slip past unnoticed?

  • Strengthen settlements and squads, or focus all power on yourself?

Core Mechanics (available in this demo):

  • Exploration & Combat: Traverse a procedurally generated world, scavenge ruins, clear dungeons, and fight mobs.

  • Economy & Resources: Gather rare materials, trade wisely, construct and upgrade buildings for powerful bonuses.

  • Army & Progression: Recruit and enhance your squad, leveling skills to unleash maximum strength.

  • Equipment & Magic: Craft legendary weapons, cast and empower devastating spells to turn the tide of battle.

This demo ends after Wave 2 — offering only the beginning of the larger battle ahead.
Add the full game to your wishlist — and become the one who closes the Gates of Hell!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or newer (64-bit)
  • Processor: Any dual core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics, 512 MB VRAM
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Resolution: 1280×720 or higher
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.05 LTS or newer (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics, 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Resolution: 1920×1080

short_description: Fantasy strategy RPG with roguelike elements. A game about choice: every mechanic is an alternative to another. Fight or bribe, craft or trade, build or cast. Find your own path and reach victory. In the demo, 3 classes and the first 3 waves of Hell are available.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese
